title: Taking the else branch
description: You can follow one comparison into its alternative branch.

steps.description: You assign 21 to age. That value will be used by the comparison below.
The if branch tests whether age is at least 35. Its indented print runs only when that comparison is True.

steps.question: Which branch runs when age is 21?
steps.answer: The else branch runs because 21 >= 35 is False.

steps.description: You see You're too young to run for President. The else branch supplies the output for this age.
